bundle.shortDescription: Organize your own Snapchat data export, on your device.
bundle.longDescription: Snappy reads the Snapchat Download My Data export that you already have, on your own device. It keeps a friend ledger, a cleanup queue and a Memories rescue. It uses friend usernames and dates only and needs no account access. Snappy itself makes no network connections; the Network use section of docs/RELEASES.md says what the system web engine may do on its own.
